title: Aosta Valley to Strasbourg via Lake Geneva
route: Courmayeur → Great St. Bernard Tunnel → Montreux → Strasbourg
intro: Leave Courmayeur at 8:30 AM and cross the Great St. Bernard Tunnel into Switzerland. Stop in Montreux for a late lunch beside Lake Geneva, then leave by 12:30 PM for Strasbourg, aiming to arrive by 5 PM.

stops.name: Courmayeur
stops.description: Leave Courmayeur after two nights beneath Mont Blanc and head east through the Aosta Valley.

stops.name: Great St. Bernard Tunnel
stops.description: Cross beneath the Alps from Italy into Switzerland through the Great St. Bernard Tunnel.

stops.name: Montreux
stops.description: Pause for a late lunch and a stretch beside Lake Geneva, then continue north toward Strasbourg.

stops.name: Strasbourg
stops.description: Arrive in Strasbourg and settle in for the night in the city's historic center.
